description.zh:
识别类型，取值：

- landmark：自定义地标。

- object：自定义物体。

- logo：自定义logo

- face：自定义人脸

- label：自定义标签
description.en:
The type of recognition algorithm. Valid values:

- landmark

- object

- logo

- face

- label

description.zh: 库ID，传入则精确查该库；支持传入列表，用","分割。
description.en: Library ID. If provided, the query returns only this specific library. A list of IDs separated by commas (",") is also supported.

description.zh: 每页数量。单页数量最大不超过 50。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

title.zh: 获取自定义识别库列表
title.en: Retrieve the List of Custom Detection Libraries

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口目前支持的地域为华北2（北京）、华东2（上海）、华东1（杭州）、华南1（深圳），其他地域暂不支持。

- 本接口的单用户 QPS 限制为 50 次/秒。超过限制，API 调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见 [QPS 限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
- This API currently supports the following Regions: China (Beijing), China (Shanghai), China (Hangzhou), and China (Shenzhen). Other Regions are not supported at this time.

- The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 50 per User. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to Rate Limiting, which may Impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).
